reasoning: The agent clearly separates parsing, scoring, and alignment generation, tracks the two deliverables distinctly against their thresholds (level 5), and goes further: it builds/verifies a scorer before optimizing, uses the numeric thresholds as done-criteria, gates saves on measured scores, and allocates more effort to the harder DM-HS deliverable — hallmarks of level 8.
